divrigiulu.name: Divriği Great Mosque and Hospital
divrigiulu.slogan: Stone carved so deep it looks woven.
divrigiulu.line: Its north portal is celebrated for the density of its high-relief stone carving; the complex was finished in 1228-29 and listed by UNESCO in 1985.

gokmedrese.name: Gök Medrese
gokmedrese.slogan: A blue-tiled school with two slim minarets over its doorway.
gokmedrese.line: Finished in 1271 for the Seljuk vizier Sahip Ata, it was designed by a Konya builder named Kaloyan.

ciftemineli.name: Çifte Minareli Medrese
ciftemineli.slogan: Two minarets, one grand Ilkhanid doorway.
ciftemineli.line: Built in 1271-72 by Shams al-Din Juvayni, an Ilkhanid vizier, the same year as the Gök Medrese across the square.

sivascongress.name: Sivas Congress Building
sivascongress.slogan: Where a new republic took shape in a school building.
sivascongress.line: From 4 to 11 September 1919, delegates met here with Mustafa Kemal and united the regional resistance groups into one national movement.

kangalkopegi.name: Kangal Dog Breeding Centre
kangalkopegi.slogan: Meet the sheepdog the whole country is proud of.
kangalkopegi.line: Since 1994 about 300 Kangal dogs have been given to Namibian farmers, cutting cheetah killings per farmer from about 19 a year to 2.4.
